get_skill_name_and_input_from_ros: get the current skill name and input from ROS parameters
reset_ros: reset all ROS parameters including skill name input and execution lock to defaults
reset_skill_msg: reset the skill success message ROS parameter to clear previous results
reset_skill_name_input: reset the skill name input and publish a success message with status
execute_skills: execute robot skills like nav pick place explore from ROS parameter buffer
